description: The ROKAF's own Mustang; jointly designated National Registered Cultural Heritage No. 666 on 2016-10-20 with the War Memorial example; the heritage citation records the type as the first fighter the Republic of Korea Air Force operated; taken over from the United States on 1950-07-02 a week after the invasion; dimensions given in the gazette are 9.8 m long by 11.3 m span by 4.2 m high; no individual serial is published
